data.long_meaning: Dwarkadas is a Sanskrit name that is a combination of two words - Dwarka and Das. Dwarka means 'a place of refuge' and Das means 'servant' or 'slave'. So, Dwarkadas means 'Lord of Dwarka' or 'Servant of Dwarka'. This name is significant in Hindu mythology as Lord Krishna is said to have resided in Dwarka, making this name a revered one.
